C1260.title: GPS Spoofing Attack Detection in Autonomous Vehicles Using Adaptive DBSCAN
C1260.summary: This study highlights that autonomous vehicles are susceptible to GPS spoofing attacks, where adversaries transmit deceptive signals to mislead the vehicle positioning system, causing erroneous navigation or hazardous maneuvers.
